- "What do you want to do? What do I do?' 
- 'What do I do?' 
- 'What do I do, what do I do, do you do?' 
You can ask the same thing, 
- 'What do you do?' 
- What do you do, 
- What do you do, 
- What do do 
- What do do 
- What do do
